versions.changelog:
Version 2.3.0

- Added a CLI references document (`references/cli_ref.md`) for command-line usage.
- Updated procedural instructions: micro-events (corrections, errors, tool failures) now log only to `.learning-trail.json`; daily logs (`memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md`) now contain only session summaries.
- Clarified session summary format and made daily log entries more concise.
- Adjusted memory architecture section for brevity and added tabular summary.
- Removed superseded documentation (`skill-card.md`).
新增：编辑文件前必须先 read 的硬规则，防止 cron 假性 error；修复：匹配逻辑支持多段前缀（如 AW-G5000-P-05）；统一 name 为 self-improvement-llm
Added export/import sync for backup and multi-server migration
Added migration script and compatibility checks for smoother updates
Synced with local workspace, MiMo model support, improved memory architecture
Updated for MiMo model support, improved memory architecture, added knowledge graph features
新增 Phase 7 auto-detect: 自动扫描 daily log 发现学习点，不再依赖 agent 手动调用；补完 9 phase 完整闭环
完整重构：精简为核心四路径（记忆→检测→记录→提炼），中文检测支持，8 phase cycle 自动闭环，修复 stats 漂移、ID 生成、promotion 去重等 bug
三层记忆架构（借鉴 Hermes Agent）、自动技能生成、会话自动摘要、标准化技能格式、preferences.json 用户模型
